object.attr: stakeholder: a rewrite has to accept exactly the same values, so no plus sign, spaces, underscores or other digits. Decided on 2026-11-10; MELLON-CHECK-SRS checks the same form. 0.3.0 writes this form and accepts whatever its parser takes (review Q21).
object.description: An object file shall hold an integer value as an optional minus sign followed by one or more of the digits 0 to 9, and nothing else.
